description: This script configures Wi-Fi interfaces, manages hostapd services, updates network configurations, and sets up web server and DHCP services for router mode operation.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service on the 2.4GHz interface.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service on the 5GHz interface, including module reloads.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills existing hostapd processes and restarts the service on wlan0.
